dedupe_keys.name: bprd trees boston park and street tree inventory

description: BPRD Trees is the City of Boston's inventory of park and street trees maintained by the Boston Parks and Recreation Department, published on the Analyze Boston open data hub and updated daily. Each record gives an id, common and botanical species names, number of stems, trunk diameter at breast height as a value and a range, the planting season when known, the open space planning neighbourhood, the park name and open space id for park trees, a street address and coordinates in EPSG:4326; street trees are those with no park value. The dataset page was created in May 2025 and its CSV and GeoJSON files were refreshed on 29 September 2026. Coverage is the City of Boston. Format and access: CSV, GeoJSON, zipped shapefile and KML downloads plus an ArcGIS REST service. Licence: Open Data Commons PDDL; free. Caveats: addresses flagged as assumed may be wrong, and private trees are not included. It supports urban heat, stormwater and storm-damage exposure studies and green infrastructure planning. Related catalogue records are the NYC 2015 Street Tree Census and the OpenTreeMap inventory platform.
